# Vesthimmerlands

Vesthimmerlands is a Danish municipality identified as part of Klynge SYD ("Cluster SOUTH"), one of the geographic health clusters participating in the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark), Denmark's national quality-improvement initiative for atrial fibrillation care [^src1]. It appears in the corpus only in a list of clusters presented within the chapter documenting Indicator 8 (Struktureret patientuddannelse / structured patient education), which surveys the geographic health clusters taking part in AFDK. No further details about Vesthimmerlands — such as population, administrative structure, or specific clinical activity — are given in the source material.
